rules.note: Copy of your passport (ID page) or national ID card.
Resume of 1 to 2 pages, in French or English.
Your higher education degrees. For master's applicants: degrees already awarded.
Transcripts since your first year of higher education, plus the official ranking certificate for your last degree or completed years.
Transcripts for the last three years.
Professional project of 1 to 2 pages, in French or English.
Motivation letter or professional project of 1 to 2 pages, in French or English.
A recommendation letter from someone outside your university, such as an internship supervisor, may support your professional project.
Scientific evaluation by a full professor or research director in your field, who must not have co-published with your expected supervisor.

French certificate only if your programme is taught in French and French is not the language of instruction in your country or university. PhD: research-language certificate if you are preselected and it applies.
Presentation of your research project and a progress report, 1 to 5 pages.
Overall financing plan for your whole PhD (a template is available).
Cotutelle agreement or co-supervision certificate signed by both sides (needed for 12- or 18-month awards). Add your registration certificate for the current year if you are enrolled.
Not listed in the official requirements.
